project: EdgePerception: Lightweight Vision-Language Perception and TensorRT Deployment on Jetson Orin

platform.device: Jetson AGX Orin Nano Developer Kit Super

fp16_50epoch.protocol: FULL COCO val2017 GT-box prompt slot0

joint_pipeline_e2e.protocol: COCO stratified 3x3 (size x scene), NanoOWL-box to NanoSAM vs GT-box to NanoSAM

nanoowl_core_trt_warm.protocol: TRT image encoder only, text embeddings cached, n=300

nanoowl_core_trt_cold.protocol: TRT image encoder + PyTorch text encoding, no cache, n=300

nanoowl_vlm_e2e.protocol: PIL load + preprocess + TRT encoder + text cached + postprocess to box, n=300

nanosam_fp16_encoder.protocol: image preprocess + TRT FP16 encoder to embedding, n=300

nanosam_fp16_decoder.protocol: embedding + box prompt to mask slot0, n=300

nanosam_int8_encoder.protocol: TRT INT8 PTQ encoder only, n=100

joint_pipeline_e2e.protocol: NanoOWL detect to bridge to NanoSAM encode+decode to mask, steady-state n=300

joint_pipeline_cached_embedding.protocol: NanoSAM embedding cached (set_image ONCE), per-prompt decode only, n=100
joint_pipeline_cached_embedding.note: NOT full pipeline FPS, cached-image scenario

cpp_runtime_nanosam.protocol: C++ TensorRT FP16, 300-iter benchmark after 30-iter warmup

deployment.camera_realtime: OUT_OF_SCOPE (offline inference only, not camera pipeline)

limitations: Not a real-time camera system - offline image + box/point prompt inference only
Not an LLM-based VLM - vision-language via CLIP text embeddings, not generative LLM
NanoOWL text side remains PyTorch (only image encoder in TensorRT)
ROS2 integration deferred to future work
No QAT - INT8 via PTQ only, quality gate FAIL for production
C++ runtime: NanoSAM only, NanoOWL text encoder not ported
